ASM-04.rationale: Strong shadow asset detection. Discovers unknown internet-facing assets, forgotten subdomains, and exposed services not in CMDB. M&A due diligence use case.

ASM-05.rationale: Continuous internet scanning with real-time change detection. Industry's most frequent scanning cadence. Alerts on new exposures, expired certificates, and configuration changes. Attack surface trending.

VUL-01.rationale: Identifies exposed services with known vulnerabilities from external perspective. Service fingerprinting and version detection. Not comprehensive vulnerability scanner.

vendors.description: Tanium provides real-time endpoint management and security at enterprise scale, combining asset discovery, vulnerability management, patch management, compliance, and threat response in a unified platform. Known for unmatched endpoint visibility and speed (seconds, not hours) even across millions of endpoints.
vendors.key_differentiators: Real-time endpoint visibility at massive scale (millions of endpoints in seconds), integrated vulnerability + patch management, linear chain architecture for speed, compliance and configuration management, Tanium Autonomous Endpoint Management with AI, strongest large enterprise/government adoption

ASM-01.rationale: Tanium provides network-based asset discovery. Identifies devices on the network in real-time. Limited external EASM capability.

ASM-02.rationale: Market leader in real-time endpoint asset inventory. Tanium Asset discovers and classifies every endpoint in seconds across millions of devices. Unmatched speed and accuracy in internal asset management.

ASM-05.rationale: Real-time change visibility. Tanium's architecture provides instant query response across all endpoints. Continuous monitoring of endpoint state changes.

VUL-01.rationale: Tanium Comply and Tanium Risk provide infrastructure vulnerability scanning. Agent-based scanning with real-time assessment. CVE coverage across Windows, Linux, macOS.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk scoring combining CVSS with asset context. Moderate risk-based prioritization compared to dedicated VM vendors.

VUL-03.rationale: Tanium Comply provides CIS, DISA STIG, and custom compliance assessment. Real-time compliance posture across all endpoints. One of the fastest compliance assessment tools.

REM-01.rationale: Market-leading automated remediation through Tanium Patch and Tanium Deploy. Automated OS and third-party patching at scale. Direct endpoint remediation without separate patch management infrastructure. Can patch 100,000+ endpoints simultaneously.

REM-02.rationale: Tanium Risk provides unified risk scoring across asset and vulnerability data. Risk trending and posture metrics.

REM-03.rationale: ServiceNow integration through Tanium Connect. Automated ticket creation and bi-directional sync. Moderate integration depth.

REM-05.rationale: Tanium dashboards with compliance posture, vulnerability trending, and patch compliance metrics. Executive reporting available.

vendors.description: Securin (formerly Cyber Security Works/CSW) is a vulnerability intelligence and management platform providing AI-driven vulnerability prioritization, attack surface management, penetration testing, and red team services. Known for vulnerability intelligence research and early prediction of exploited vulnerabilities using AI/ML.
vendors.key_differentiators: AI-driven vulnerability prediction (predicts exploitation before CISA KEV listing), deep vulnerability intelligence research, combined platform + services model (VM + pentest + red team), ransomware vulnerability mapping, weaponization tracking ahead of NVD/CISA, EPSS enhancement through proprietary threat intelligence

ASM-01.rationale: Securin VI (Vulnerability Intelligence) includes attack surface context. Identifies exposed assets through vulnerability intelligence correlation. Not dedicated EASM platform.

VUL-01.rationale: Securin provides vulnerability scanning and management platform. Coverage across infrastructure and applications. Growing scanning capability.

VUL-02.rationale: Strong risk-based prioritization powered by Securin's proprietary vulnerability intelligence. Combines CVSS, EPSS, weaponization data, and ransomware association. Named for predictive vulnerability prioritization.

VUL-03.rationale: Configuration and compliance assessment available. CIS and regulatory benchmark support. Moderate depth.

VUL-05.rationale: Securin's core differentiator is vulnerability intelligence. Tracks exploit weaponization, ransomware association, APT group usage, and CISA KEV correlation. Predictive exploitability scoring. One of the most detailed vulnerability intelligence databases.

OFT-01.rationale: Securin offers pen testing services. Expert-led rather than automated platform.

REM-02.rationale: Securin Risk-Based Vulnerability Management provides exposure prioritization. Aggregates vulnerability and threat intelligence for unified risk scoring.

REM-03.rationale: ServiceNow and Jira integrations. Automated ticket creation with vulnerability intelligence context.

REM-05.rationale: Reporting dashboards with vulnerability trending, risk metrics, and remediation progress. Executive reporting available.

vendors.description: Cobalt is a Pentest as a Service (PTaaS) platform that combines human pentesters from a vetted global community (Cobalt Core) with a SaaS platform for managing, tracking, and remediating findings. Provides web app, API, mobile, network, and cloud penetration testing with fast turnaround and continuous engagement options.
vendors.key_differentiators: PTaaS model with vetted pentester community (Cobalt Core), fast engagement start (average 2-day launch), SaaS platform for finding management and remediation tracking, compliance-ready reporting (SOC 2, PCI, ISO), API and DevSecOps integration, transparent pricing model

OFT-01.rationale: Cobalt provides Pentest as a Service (PtaaS), combining a vetted global pen testing community with a platform-based delivery model. Web, API, mobile, cloud, and network pen testing. Fast engagement launches (within days). Named in Gartner Market Guide for PtaaS.

OFT-02.rationale: Limited BAS. Human-driven pen testing rather than automated simulation.

OFT-03.rationale: Red team engagements available through expert pentester community. Not automated; relies on skilled human operators.

APP-01.rationale: Application security pen testing covering web and mobile applications. Manual testing with OWASP methodology. Expert-driven DAST coverage.

APP-02.rationale: API penetration testing covering REST and GraphQL APIs. OWASP API Top 10 manual testing. Expert validation of API security.

REM-03.rationale: Jira, GitHub, and Slack integrations. Finding-to-fix workflows. Cobalt platform manages remediation tracking.

REM-05.rationale: Professional pen test reports through the platform. Executive summaries, finding details, and remediation guidance. Engagement history and trend tracking.

vendors.description: Recorded Future is the world's largest threat intelligence company, providing AI-powered intelligence across the vulnerability management and exposure management lifecycle. The Intelligence Cloud aggregates and analyzes data from the widest set of sources to provide vulnerability risk scoring, exploit prediction, and threat context enrichment.
vendors.key_differentiators: Largest threat intelligence platform (1M+ sources), AI-powered vulnerability risk scoring, exploit prediction ahead of CISA KEV, broadest dark web and threat actor coverage, Recorded Future AI for natural language intelligence queries, acquired by Mastercard for $2.65B, vulnerability intelligence integrated with threat context

ASM-01.rationale: Recorded Future Attack Surface Intelligence provides external asset discovery with threat intelligence enrichment. Identifies exposed assets and correlates with active targeting.

ASM-05.rationale: Continuous monitoring with threat-informed alerting. Alerts when new assets are identified or when existing assets are targeted by threats.

VUL-02.rationale: Recorded Future Vulnerability Intelligence provides best-in-class vulnerability prioritization. Combines CVSS with real-time exploit data, dark web intelligence, and threat actor targeting. Named in Gartner MQ for Security Risk Management.

VUL-05.rationale: Market leader in threat intelligence. Intelligence Cloud correlates vulnerabilities with dark web discussions, paste sites, exploit markets, and threat actor activity. Acquired by Mastercard for $2.65B in 2024. Unmatched breadth of intelligence sources (1M+ sources in 13 languages).

OFT-05.rationale: Threat intelligence supports adversary emulation planning. Provides threat actor profiles, TTPs, and targeting data. Not native emulation platform but essential intelligence input.

vendors.description: FireCompass is an AI-driven Continuous Automated Red Teaming (CART) and attack surface management platform. Combines autonomous discovery of external attack surface with automated multi-stage attack playbooks that simulate real adversary behavior. Recognized in Gartner Hype Cycle for Security Operations. Platform discovers shadow IT, ranks attack paths, and continuously validates exposures without manual intervention.
vendors.key_differentiators: Fully autonomous red teaming without human operators, continuous ASM + automated penetration testing in single platform, AI-prioritized attack path analysis, multi-stage attack chain simulation, Gartner Hype Cycle recognition for CART, strong APAC enterprise client base

ASM-01.rationale: FireCompass EASM provides continuous external attack surface discovery. Automated reconnaissance across domains, IPs, and cloud assets. Strong asset enumeration capability.

ASM-02.rationale: Internal asset discovery through network scanning as part of CART workflows. Moderate internal inventory depth.

ASM-03.rationale: Cloud asset discovery within EASM context. Multi-cloud external exposure identification.

ASM-04.rationale: Shadow IT and forgotten asset detection through internet-wide reconnaissance. Identifies orphaned subdomains, exposed dev environments, and untracked assets.

ASM-05.rationale: Continuous monitoring with real-time alerting on new external exposures. Attack surface change tracking and trending.

VUL-01.rationale: Vulnerability identification through reconnaissance and scanning as part of CART workflow. Not standalone VM platform.

VUL-03.rationale: Basic configuration checks as part of attack surface analysis. Limited compliance benchmarking depth.

VUL-04.rationale: Autonomous exploitation validates real vulnerabilities. CART platform safely exploits findings to prove impact. Strong exploitability validation.

OFT-01.rationale: Continuous Automated Red Teaming (CART) platform provides autonomous pen testing. Multi-stage attack chains without human operators. Recognized in Gartner Hype Cycle for Security Operations. Growing APAC presence.

OFT-02.rationale: Some attack simulation capability within CART framework. Tests security controls through automated attack sequences.

OFT-03.rationale: Autonomous multi-stage red team campaigns. Automated credential harvesting, lateral movement, and privilege escalation. AI-driven attack planning and execution.

OFT-04.rationale: Attack path discovery through automated exploitation chains. Identifies paths from external entry to critical assets.

OFT-05.rationale: MITRE ATT&CK alignment in attack technique library. Growing technique coverage. Threat-informed testing scenarios.

REM-02.rationale: Risk-based finding prioritization based on proven exploitability. Attack path context in remediation recommendations.

REM-05.rationale: Assessment reports with exploitation proof and remediation guidance. Executive summaries and trending.

vendors.description: Indusface provides a managed application security platform combining DAST, SAST, API security scanning, and web application firewall (WAF) capabilities. Named in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud WAAP. Platform integrates automated vulnerability scanning with expert manual pen testing and virtual patching for rapid remediation. Strong presence across APAC and Middle East enterprise markets.
vendors.key_differentiators: Gartner MQ recognized for Cloud WAAP, integrated DAST + WAF + manual pen testing in single platform, zero false-positive guarantee with expert validation, managed security service model, AppTrana risk-based protection, strong APAC-Middle East client base

ASM-01.rationale: Indusface WAS provides web asset discovery. Identifies web applications and APIs. Limited compared to dedicated EASM platforms.

ASM-02.rationale: Basic web application inventory. Not comprehensive internal asset management.

VUL-01.rationale: Web application vulnerability scanning through Indusface WAS. OWASP Top 10 and beyond. Automated + manual hybrid scanning. Moderate infrastructure VM capability.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization combining automated findings with expert manual validation. Zero false positive guarantee reduces noise.

VUL-03.rationale: Basic compliance scanning for web applications. PCI DSS and OWASP compliance. Limited infrastructure compliance.

APP-01.rationale: Strong DAST capabilities through Indusface WAS and AppTrana. Named in Gartner MQ for Cloud WAAP (AppTrana). Automated + expert manual pen testing hybrid. OWASP Top 10 coverage. Zero false positive validation.

APP-02.rationale: API security testing covering REST and GraphQL APIs. Automated API scanning with manual validation. OWASP API Top 10 testing. AppTrana includes API protection.

APP-03.rationale: Limited SCA capability. Focus is on web application and API testing rather than source code dependency analysis.

APP-04.rationale: CI/CD integration available through APIs. Jenkins and pipeline integration for scheduled scanning. Moderate DevSecOps integration depth.

APP-05.rationale: Limited cloud-native application security. Focus is web application and WAF/WAAP rather than containers or IaC.

REM-01.rationale: AppTrana WAF provides virtual patching for detected vulnerabilities. Automated blocking of exploitation attempts without code changes. Key differentiator: immediate risk reduction.

REM-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization combining automated and manual findings. AppTrana risk scoring for web application exposure.

vendors.description: CloudSEK is an AI-powered digital risk monitoring and external attack surface management platform. Uses contextual AI (XVigil platform) to monitor the surface, deep, and dark web for digital threats, brand impersonation, data leaks, and exposed assets. Provides automated takedown capabilities and threat intelligence. Growing presence across APAC financial services and government sectors.
vendors.key_differentiators: AI-driven contextual threat intelligence across surface/deep/dark web, automated digital asset discovery and monitoring, brand protection and impersonation detection, automated takedown orchestration, strong BFSI and government client base in India/Southeast Asia

ASM-01.rationale: CloudSEK XVigil provides AI-driven external attack surface discovery. Monitors surface, deep, and dark web for exposed assets and digital threats. Strong digital footprint monitoring.

ASM-02.rationale: Limited internal asset inventory. Focus is external digital risk monitoring.

ASM-03.rationale: Cloud exposure monitoring for leaked credentials, misconfigured storage, and exposed cloud services. Limited depth compared to CSPM tools.

ASM-04.rationale: Strong shadow IT and digital risk detection. Discovers brand impersonation, phishing domains, rogue apps, and exposed credentials across dark web. Core differentiator.

ASM-05.rationale: Continuous monitoring across surface, deep, and dark web with real-time alerts. Digital threat monitoring with trending and change detection.

VUL-01.rationale: Limited vulnerability scanning. Focus is digital risk intelligence rather than traditional VM.

VUL-03.rationale: Basic exposure assessment. Not traditional configuration compliance platform.

REM-02.rationale: Risk-based alert prioritization using AI contextual analysis. Prioritizes digital threats by business impact.

REM-05.rationale: Threat intelligence dashboards with digital risk trending. Executive reporting on brand exposure and digital threats.

vendors.description: SecPod provides the SanerNow platform for continuous vulnerability and exposure management. Combines vulnerability assessment, compliance monitoring, patch management, and endpoint management in a unified agent-based architecture. Maintains one of the world's largest vulnerability intelligence databases (175,000+ checks). Strong adoption in APAC mid-market and government sectors.
vendors.key_differentiators: 175,000+ vulnerability checks (one of industry's largest databases), unified VM + patch management + compliance in single agent, SanerNow continuous posture management, integrated remediation with zero-touch patching, competitive pricing for mid-market, STIGS/CIS compliance automation

ASM-01.rationale: SanerNow provides network-based asset discovery. Identifies devices and services on internal and perimeter networks. Agent-based discovery.

ASM-02.rationale: SanerNow asset inventory with classification. Agent-based endpoint enumeration with OS, application, and hardware details. Moderate depth.

VUL-01.rationale: SanerNow CVEM provides vulnerability scanning with 175,000+ vulnerability checks, one of the industry's largest databases. Agent-based continuous scanning across Windows, Linux, macOS. SCAP-compatible.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization available. CVSS and exploitability data for finding priority. Growing beyond basic prioritization.

VUL-03.rationale: SanerNow Compliance Management provides CIS benchmark, DISA STIG, and custom compliance assessment. SCAP-compatible benchmark automation across endpoints. Strong compliance depth.

VUL-04.rationale: Limited exploitability validation. Relies on vulnerability intelligence rather than active exploitation.

VUL-05.rationale: Vulnerability intelligence database with threat context. Exploit availability and active threat correlation. Moderate depth vs. dedicated threat intelligence vendors.

REM-01.rationale: SanerNow integrated patch management is a key differentiator. Zero-touch automated patching for OS and 400+ third-party applications. Unified VM + patching in single agent. Competitive with Qualys for integrated remediation.

REM-02.rationale: Unified risk view across vulnerability, compliance, and patch status. Risk trending and posture metrics.

REM-03.rationale: Basic ticketing and workflow integrations. ServiceNow and Jira integration available. Growing ITSM integration depth.

vendors.description: Astra Security provides an automated penetration testing and vulnerability scanning platform for web applications, APIs, mobile apps, and cloud infrastructure. Combines automated DAST scanning with expert-led manual pen testing and compliance-focused reporting (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA). Growing rapidly among SaaS companies and mid-market enterprises seeking continuous security validation.
vendors.key_differentiators: Automated pen testing + manual expert validation hybrid model, compliance-focused reporting for SOC 2/ISO 27001/HIPAA, developer-friendly integrations (CI/CD, Jira, Slack), affordable pricing for SMB/SaaS companies, zero false-positive guarantee, visual vulnerability dashboard

ASM-01.rationale: Basic external asset discovery as part of pen testing workflow. Limited EASM depth.

VUL-01.rationale: Automated vulnerability scanning for web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. 9,300+ security tests. Growing scanning capability.

VUL-02.rationale: Basic risk-based prioritization by severity. Less sophisticated than enterprise VM vendor prioritization.

OFT-01.rationale: Astra Pentest provides automated pen testing for web apps, APIs, and cloud. Combines automated DAST scanning with manual expert validation. SaaS-delivered with developer-friendly interface.

OFT-02.rationale: Limited BAS capability. Focused on pen testing and vulnerability scanning.

OFT-03.rationale: Manual expert pen testing component provides some red team capability. Not automated red team platform.

APP-01.rationale: DAST scanning for web applications with OWASP Top 10 coverage. Automated + manual expert validation. Zero false positive guarantee. Developer-friendly vulnerability dashboard.

APP-02.rationale: API security testing for REST and GraphQL APIs. OWASP API Top 10 coverage. Automated + manual API pen testing.

APP-04.rationale: CI/CD integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, and others. Automated security scanning in pipelines. Developer-friendly reporting with Jira, Slack integration.

vendors.description: NSFOCUS is one of China's largest cybersecurity vendors, providing vulnerability management, WAF, DDoS protection, and threat intelligence platforms. NSFOCUS RSAS (Remote Security Assessment System) is one of the most widely deployed vulnerability scanners in APAC. Serves major enterprises, telecommunications, and government clients across China, Southeast Asia, and Middle East. Gartner recognized for DDoS mitigation and WAF.
vendors.key_differentiators: Market leader in China for vulnerability assessment, RSAS widely deployed across APAC government and telecom, integrated VM + WAF + DDoS + threat intelligence platform, strong vulnerability research lab (M01N Team), Gartner recognized in DDoS/WAF markets, extensive APAC channel partner network

ASM-01.rationale: NSFOCUS provides network and perimeter asset discovery. Internet-facing asset enumeration through RSAS scanning engine. Strong in Chinese and APAC enterprise market.

ASM-02.rationale: Internal asset discovery through RSAS network scanning. Asset inventory with classification. CMDB integration for Chinese enterprise environments.

ASM-03.rationale: Limited cloud security. Growing cloud coverage for Chinese cloud providers (Alibaba, Huawei, Tencent). Less multi-cloud depth than Western CSPMs.

VUL-01.rationale: NSFOCUS RSAS is one of the most widely deployed vulnerability scanners in China and APAC. Comprehensive infrastructure scanning. 80,000+ vulnerability checks. Agent-based and agentless scanning.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization available. CVSS-based with NSFOCUS threat intelligence context. Growing beyond basic prioritization.

VUL-03.rationale: Strong compliance assessment for Chinese regulations (MLPS 2.0) and international standards (CIS, ISO 27001). Configuration auditing across infrastructure. Important for Chinese regulated industries.

VUL-04.rationale: Limited exploitability validation. Primarily scanning-based assessment without active exploitation.

VUL-05.rationale: NSFOCUS M01N research team provides vulnerability intelligence. Chinese threat landscape expertise. CVE research and advisory publication. Moderate global intelligence depth.

APP-01.rationale: NSFOCUS WebSafe provides web application scanning and WAF capabilities. OWASP coverage. Focus on Chinese web application environment.

APP-02.rationale: Basic API testing through web scanning engine. Limited dedicated API security.

APP-05.rationale: Growing cloud-native security capabilities. Container scanning emerging. Limited IaC and Kubernetes depth.

REM-01.rationale: NSFOCUS provides some automated remediation through WAF virtual patching and DDoS mitigation. Infrastructure remediation workflows.

REM-02.rationale: Basic risk scoring and prioritization. ISOP platform provides some unified security operations view.

REM-03.rationale: Integration with Chinese ITSM platforms. Limited global ITSM integration (ServiceNow, Jira).

vendors.description: NTT Security Holdings is the cybersecurity arm of NTT Group, one of the world's largest telecommunications companies. Provides managed security services, offensive security testing (red team, pen testing), vulnerability management, and threat intelligence globally. Samurai MDRP platform integrates vulnerability assessment with managed detection and response. Significant offensive security consulting practice across APAC, with teams in Japan, Australia, and Singapore.
vendors.key_differentiators: Backed by NTT Group (Fortune Global 500), global offensive security consulting practice, Samurai MDRP managed security platform, deep vulnerability research capability, extensive APAC presence (Japan/Australia/Singapore/India), managed pen testing and red team services at scale

ASM-01.rationale: NTT provides attack surface discovery through managed security services. External asset enumeration as part of assessment engagements.

ASM-02.rationale: Asset inventory through managed security services and NTT MDR platform. Network-based discovery across managed client environments.

ASM-03.rationale: Cloud security assessment services across AWS, Azure, GCP. Part of managed security practice rather than self-service platform.

ASM-05.rationale: Continuous monitoring through NTT managed security services. SOC-driven monitoring and alerting on security events.

VUL-01.rationale: NTT provides vulnerability management through managed services using commercial scanning engines (Qualys, Tenable partnerships). Expert-managed VM programs.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization through expert analysis. Managed VM services include contextual prioritization by NTT security analysts.

VUL-03.rationale: Compliance assessment as part of managed security services. CIS, PCI DSS, and regulatory compliance auditing.

VUL-04.rationale: Exploitability validation through manual pen testing engagements. NTT offensive security team validates critical vulnerabilities.

OFT-01.rationale: NTT provides expert-led penetration testing services globally. Experienced pen testing teams across APAC (Japan, Australia, Singapore). Network, web, mobile, and cloud pen testing.

OFT-02.rationale: Some BAS capability through managed security technology stack. Moderate compared to dedicated BAS platforms.

OFT-03.rationale: NTT Red Team services are well-regarded particularly in APAC. Experienced red team operators with adversary simulation capability. Purple team engagements available.

APP-01.rationale: Application security testing services. Web and mobile application pen testing. Expert-led SAST/DAST assessment.

APP-02.rationale: API security assessment through pen testing engagements. Manual API testing with expert validation.

REM-01.rationale: Limited automated remediation. Managed services provide remediation guidance rather than direct automated patching.

REM-02.rationale: Risk-based prioritization through managed VM program. Analyst-driven exposure management.

REM-05.rationale: Managed security reporting with executive dashboards. Monthly reporting on security posture, vulnerability trends, and remediation progress.

vendors.description: Entersoft Security is an Australian offensive security firm providing penetration testing, red team assessments, application security testing, and attack surface management. Combines automated scanning technology with expert-led offensive testing. Strong presence in Australian financial services, government, and critical infrastructure sectors. CREST-certified and ASD-listed security assessor.
vendors.key_differentiators: CREST-certified and ASD (Australian Signals Directorate) listed assessor, deep Australian government and critical infrastructure experience, hybrid automated + expert-led offensive testing, web/mobile/API/network/cloud pen testing coverage, strong ANZ financial services client base, compliance-aligned reporting (APRA CPS 234, Essential Eight)

ASM-01.rationale: Entersoft provides external attack surface discovery as part of pen testing engagements. Asset enumeration and exposure mapping. Australian market focus.

ASM-02.rationale: Internal asset enumeration through pen testing reconnaissance. Not standalone asset management platform.

VUL-01.rationale: Vulnerability scanning as part of security assessment services. Commercial and open-source scanning tools combined with expert analysis.

VUL-02.rationale: Risk-based finding prioritization by pen testing experts. Moderate prioritization sophistication.

OFT-01.rationale: Core offering is expert-led penetration testing. CREST-certified and ASD (Australian Signals Directorate) listed assessor. Comprehensive pen testing across web, mobile, API, network, and cloud. Strong Australian government and financial services experience.

OFT-02.rationale: Limited BAS capability. Expert-driven testing rather than automated simulation.

OFT-03.rationale: Red team assessment services. Experienced offensive security operators. Adversary simulation for Australian enterprises and government agencies.

OFT-04.rationale: Some attack path analysis within red team engagements. Not automated graph-based platform.

APP-01.rationale: Web and mobile application security testing. OWASP methodology. Expert-led DAST and code review. Strong in Australian regulated sectors.

APP-02.rationale: API penetration testing. REST and GraphQL API security assessment. Manual expert API testing.

vendors.description: NetSPI is the pioneer of Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS), combining 350+ in-house penetration testers with purpose-built AI to deliver continuous, human-led, AI-accelerated cybersecurity testing. Founded in 2001, NetSPI provides application, network, cloud, hardware, AI/ML, and mainframe pentesting, along with attack surface management, red team operations, social engineering, detective controls testing, and threat modeling. GigaOm Radar Leader and Outperformer for PTaaS 2025. Serves 9 of 10 top US banks, 3 of 5 largest cloud providers, and all 5 MAMAA tech giants.
vendors.key_differentiators: Pioneer of PTaaS model with 20+ year track record, 350+ in-house (not outsourced) pentesters, human-led AI-accelerated methodology, 50+ pentesting service types including AI/ML and mainframe, GigaOm Radar Leader and Outperformer for PTaaS 2025, attack surface visibility with continuous scanning, detective controls testing and attack simulation, Microsoft AI security framework partnership, open API with asset/IAM/vulnerability/ticketing integrations, KKR-backed

ASM-01.rationale: NetSPI Attack Surface Visibility provides external attack surface discovery with continuous scanning of external perimeter and internal assets. Integrates across identities, applications, and devices. Weekly external asset discovery scans, AWS and Azure security scans, dark web monitoring, and look-alike domain monitoring. Automatic asset inventory and deduplication.

excerpts.excerpt: With NetSPI, you gain an always-on understanding of your attack surface, both internal and external. NetSPI automatically scans your external perimeter and internal assets with integrations across identities, applications, and devices.
Attack Surface Visibility: Asset inventory and deduplication, External asset discovery scans weekly, AWS and Azure security scans weekly, Dark web monitoring, Look-alike domain monitoring.

EAB Global improves attack surface security within 15 seconds using NetSPI Attack Surface Visibility Solutions. Brian Markham, CISO: NetSPI Attack Surface Visibility has saved EAB Global time, money, and helped us mature our program.

ASM-01.notes: NetSPI Attack Surface Visibility is a standalone product with weekly discovery scans and continuous monitoring. Customer validation from EAB Global CISO.
